components.css: .ds-field{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;font:600 14px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI','Noto Sans TC','Microsoft JhengHei',sans-serif;color:var(--ink,#1d1d1f)}.ds-field span{font-size:12px;font-weight:400;color:var(--muted,#626267)}.ds-number{width:70px;min-height:44px;border:0;border-radius:8px;background:#f5f5f7;color:var(--ink,#1d1d1f);caret-color:var(--accent,#0071e3);text-align:center;font:inherit;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-number:disabled{cursor:not-allowed}.ds-primary:focus-visible,.ds-reset:focus-visible,.ds-number:focus-visible,.ds-mode button:focus-visible,.ds-upload:focus-visible,.ds-header a:focus-visible,.ds-header select:focus-visible,.ds-clip:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent,#0071e3);outline-offset:4px}

components.css: .ds-mode{display:inline-flex;max-width:100%;padding:4px;gap:4px;border-radius:12px;background:#f5f5f7}.ds-mode button{min-height:44px;border:0;border-radius:8px;padding:8px 22px;color:var(--muted,#626267);background:transparent;font:15px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI','Noto Sans TC','Microsoft JhengHei',sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:background .15s,color .15s}.ds-mode button[aria-pressed=true]{background:#fff;color:var(--ink,#1d1d1f)}.ds-mode button:hover:enabled{color:var(--ink,#1d1d1f)}.ds-mode button:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:not-allowed}@media(max-width:740px){.ds-mode{display:flex}.ds-mode button{flex:1;padding:8px 10px}}.ds-primary:focus-visible,.ds-reset:focus-visible,.ds-number:focus-visible,.ds-mode button:focus-visible,.ds-upload:focus-visible,.ds-header a:focus-visible,.ds-header select:focus-visible,.ds-clip:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent,#0071e3);outline-offset:4px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){button{transition:none}}

components.css: .ds-clip{display:grid;justify-items:center;gap:8px;min-height:136px;min-width:0;padding:18px 12px;border:1px solid var(--line,#d2d2d7);border-radius:12px;background:#fff;color:var(--ink,#1d1d1f);font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI','Noto Sans TC','Microsoft JhengHei',sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:background .15s,color .15s}.ds-clip[aria-pressed=true]{border:2px solid var(--accent,#0071e3);padding:17px 11px}.ds-clip strong{font-size:14px;font-weight:600}.ds-clip span{max-width:100%;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted,#626267)}.ds-clip:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:not-allowed}@media(max-width:740px){.ds-clip{min-height:126px;padding:14px 8px}.ds-clip[aria-pressed=true]{padding:13px 7px}}.ds-primary:focus-visible,.ds-reset:focus-visible,.ds-number:focus-visible,.ds-mode button:focus-visible,.ds-upload:focus-visible,.ds-header a:focus-visible,.ds-header select:focus-visible,.ds-clip:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent,#0071e3);outline-offset:4px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){button{transition:none}}

narrative.overview:
Preserve the existing name and phone mark in `public/brand/mark.svg`. The confirmed direction is inspired by Apple's website: white and light gray surfaces, system typography, blue actions and a large video preview. The existing purple logo remains an identity asset; it does not define the interaction palette or imply Apple affiliation.

This is the implemented editor, documented from the final CSS cascade in `src/styles.css` and its React components. It is a code-led design with no approved image comp. The preview, upload and adjustment areas sit directly on the page, with space and typography establishing hierarchy.
keyCharacteristics: A large working preview with quiet surrounding controls.
Neutral surfaces and blue interaction states.
Main actions remain on the right; errors appear at the top.
The existing phone logo and multilingual product name stay recognizable.
dos: Do preserve the product name and existing phone logo.
Do keep the video visually dominant and the surrounding editor quiet.
Do reserve space for right-side actions at every viewport width.
Do retain visible replacement wording after upload on mobile.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus, readable states and reduced-motion support.
donts: Don't reintroduce boxed cards around every editor section.
Don't replace the system typography or blue action palette with the logo's purple.
Don't hide errors below the content or move primary actions into a mobile bottom bar.
Don't confuse dragging the floating preview with changing the video crop.
Don't describe local viewport screenshots as physical-phone or deployed verification.
